title: Development launcher
summary: Claimed source commands bind the checkout interpreter, including native Windows python.exe and yoke.exe invocations. Disposable evidence uses the native temporary directory on Windows and Linux; macOS uses the short /tmp path needed by PostgreSQL sockets. Contributor tooling changes do not establish a Windows product support claim. On Windows, test-cluster start/env output uses literal PowerShell environment assignments. Contributor smoke checkouts disable Git symlinks; Windows collects the declared test roster before execution, and Mac/Linux source smoke reuses that roster.
